request: Create a source-analysis lesson. Students should build the narrowest supported timeline for the rehearsal cue failure, distinguish event time from documentation time, and explain whether the two accounts conflict.
objective: Resolve a dated relative-time statement and compare it with a later broad recollection without inventing time precision.

sources.text: Fictional theatre notebook, entry dated14 May2025: “Yesterday, during the evening rehearsal, the balcony cue light failed.” The notebook identifies rehearsal B-17 and the balcony cue light.
An interview recorded2 June2025 says: “I remember that balcony cue-light failure in rehearsal B-17 happening sometime in May.” The interviewer did not ask for a day.
A repair invoice dated16 May2025 records replacement of the balcony cue-light connector; it does not state the failure date or exact rehearsal time.
